name: Specular Reflections
description: The specular (image source) reflection paths from the scene's sources to its receivers, by order: each path as a polyline from the source over its wall hits to the receiver, with its image source, order, walls and travel time.

inputParameters.name: order
inputParameters.description: Reflection order(s) to give, 0 for the direct sound; negative orders are left out. Empty (default): the first order.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of the source, in the order of the scene's sources. Empty (default): every source.

inputParameters.name: receiver_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of the receiver, in the order of the scene's receivers. Empty (default): every receiver.

outputParameters.name: reflections
outputParameters.description: The SpecularReflections object, the paths of the chosen orders and pair.

outputParameters.name: paths
outputParameters.description: The reflection paths as polylines, from the source over the wall hits to the receiver.

outputParameters.name: images
outputParameters.description: The image source of each path as a point.

outputParameters.name: order
outputParameters.description: The reflection order of each path.

outputParameters.name: walls
outputParameters.description: The name of the object each reflection of a path is off, in path order: a branch per path.

outputParameters.name: time
outputParameters.description: The travel time of each path in milliseconds.
